disclosure: Fictional AI concepts; not photographs of manufactured merchandise. Original files preserved.
physicalPromptTemplate: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: VieWorld fictional fan-world shop catalog image, {name}. Primary request: {subject} Scene/backdrop: clean warm ivory seamless studio background #f8f6f0, soft contact shadow. Composition: square image, single centered product or the specified album set, object occupies 65 percent, ample breathing room, entire silhouette visible. Lighting: soft warm window/softbox light, high-end catalog aesthetic consistent with a welcoming wood-and-ivory fan world. No props, no people, no UI, no watermark, no real brand names or logos, no text except explicitly requested. Generate ONE final image.

assets.subject: A single premium oversized ivory cotton fan merchandise T-shirt, embroidered small olive-green five-point star on left chest and subtle olive ribbed collar. Photorealistic real fabric weave, draped naturally on an invisible mannequin, front three-quarter view, no human or hanger.

A single premium sage-olive cotton baseball cap, small cream five-point star embroidered on the front, curved brim, visible subtle stitching, adjustable back. Photorealistic product photography, three-quarter view.

A physical music CD album set: one cream paper sleeve with an abstract olive-green star and midnight-blue concentric music grooves, a silver compact disc partially sliding out. Photorealistic paper texture and metallic diffraction, tasteful minimal cover, no faces.

An original fan concert lightstick, warm ivory ergonomic handle, clear spherical head enclosing a simple olive-green five-point star illuminated mint-green, short cream wrist strap. Photorealistic transparent acrylic, restrained glow. It must be an original design, not any existing band's lightstick.

One premium virtual membership pass floating at a slight angle, deep olive rounded card with embossed gold five-point star, finely etched concentric rings, mint edge glow. Only text 'MEMBER' and small 'DEMO'. Stylized polished 3D game collectible, no QR code, barcode, personal data, or real-world ticket validation.

One virtual concert ticket collectible floating at a slight angle, midnight-purple paper-like card with scalloped short edges, cream star, subtle mint stage-beam motif. Only text 'LIVE HOUSE' and small 'DEMO'. Stylized polished 3D game collectible, no QR code, barcode, date, seat, or redeemable code.
